subject: Next steps: NovaCorp security intake — VSQ kickoff, SOC 2 Type II report & bridge letter
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novacorp.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@novacorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: NovaCorp security intake — VSQ kickoff, SOC 2 Type II report & bridge letter

Hi Elena / Tom —

Great to meet earlier today — appreciate you taking the time to walk through NovaCorp’s platform and priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we don’t lose momentum: 

Summary of call:
- NovaCorp is evaluating Redwood to power inference for two product lines (Realtime Assist and Batch Indexing).
- Security / compliance is the gating factor for procurement: SOC 2 Type II, data residency and GDPR controls, and proof of secure handling for PHI (HIPAA) are top requirements.

Immediate asks we discussed:
1) Share your vendor security questionnaire (VSQ) or DDQ. If you can, please send the spreadsheet and any fields you want us to prioritize.
2) Request access to our trust portal where we host SOC 2 reports, bridge letters, and configuration docs. If the Type II report is not yet public, a temporary attestation/bridge letter will work for procurement.
3) Identify a primary intake owner on your side for evidence uploads and procurement coordination (you mentioned Tom?).

What I’ll do from Redwood:
- Attach a short SOC 2 Type II summary and our bridge letter template for you to review.
- Start VSQ answers in parallel; we’ll fill the high-priority items first and tag PHI/GDPR-related controls.
- Kick off portal provisioning for NovaCorp so you can retrieve artifacts (I’ve looped Karthik for access).

Proposed timeline:
- 48–72 hours: initial VSQ intake and portal invite.
- 5 business days: draft responses for core security, GDPR, and HIPAA questions.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf, bridge_letter_template.pdf (attached)

Are you available for a quick 30-min intake next week (suggest Tuesday 4/24 10:00–10:30 PT)?

Thanks — looking forward to making this easy.

—
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@novacorp.com>

Date: 2028-04-18T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: NovaCorp security intake — VSQ kickoff, SOC 2 Type II report & bridge letter

Jordan —

Thanks for the recap and the materials. Quick notes from our side:

- I’m attaching our vendor security questionnaire (saved as nova_ddq_questions.xlsx). We’ll prioritize PHI / GDPR / access control items — Tom will be the procurement lead.
- We need either the SOC 2 Type II report or a bridge letter/temporary attestation to align with internal risk policy. If your trust portal has a restricted access view we can use, that would be ideal.
- A few HIPAA-specific questions will need clarification (audit logs retention, encryption for backups at rest and in transit).

Tom and I are available for Tuesday 4/24 10:00 PT. Please send the portal invite to security@novacorp.com (this account forwards to our intake team).

Attachments: nova_ddq_questions.xlsx

Best,
Elena Martinez
Head of InfoSec, NovaCorp
elena.martinez@novacorp.com | +1 212-555-0227

I’ll schedule the 4/24 intake and send a calendar invite.

Jordan
